topic: Why Itachi never cast Tsukuyomi on Naruto: the eye-contact rule, the Contact fight under Kabuto's control, and the cost argument
title: Why Itachi Never Used Tsukuyomi On Naruto
description:
Itachi had one of the most feared genjutsu in Naruto, and across the fights we see he never cast it on Naruto. This theory walks through the eye-contact rule, the Jiraiya standoff where he backed off, and the Contact episode where Kabuto was steering him. Was the restraint about cost, mercy, or strategy? I lean toward a mix of all three.

comment: Was Itachi saving Tsukuyomi for Sasuke, or was Naruto never worth the eyes? Pick one.

lines.text: Standing on the wall, he tells Kisame he has no affection for Konoha at all. I don't buy that for a second.

shot.fallback: itachi kisame konoha wall anime scene

lines.text: Jiraiya is gone, lured off by a woman under Itachi's own genjutsu. The setup is careful.

shot.fallback: jiraiya itachi genjutsu woman anime scene

lines.text: Then Sasuke bursts in with a Chidori, and Itachi breaks his wrist like it's nothing.

shot.fallback: sasuke chidori itachi shukuba anime scene

lines.text: Now Jiraiya comes back. Itachi doesn't want a fight with him.

shot.fallback: jiraiya returns shukuba itachi anime scene

lines.text: But he still takes the time to put Sasuke under Tsukuyomi, replaying their parents' deaths.

shot.fallback: itachi tsukuyomi sasuke parents memory anime scene

lines.text: Then he turns to escape, and Jiraiya tries to pin them with a Toad Mouth Bind.

shot.fallback: jiraiya toad mouth bind anime scene

lines.text: Itachi answers with Amaterasu, black flames, and he and Kisame break through.

shot.fallback: itachi amaterasu black flames jiraiya anime scene

lines.text: Look at what he spends there. Black flames, not Tsukuyomi. Not the eyes.

shot.fallback: itachi amaterasu eye anime scene

lines.text: The most common fan answer is his illness. Every jutsu drained his life force.

shot.fallback: itachi uchiha ill coughing anime scene

lines.text: That's a clean explanation, and clean explanations make me suspicious.

shot.fallback: ninja staring with a suspicious look

lines.text: Because he had just paid for Tsukuyomi on Sasuke, with Jiraiya already standing there.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke tsukuyomi jiraiya anime scene

lines.text: One analysis reads him as a spy protecting Konoha, not a fighter chasing a win.

shot.fallback: ninja hiding in the shadows of a village

lines.text: A spy doesn't need a dramatic win. A spy needs to stay inside and stay alive.

shot.fallback: itachi uchiha akatsuki spy anime scene

lines.text: Here's the detail most people forget. Guy later says he attacked Jiraiya by mistake.

shot.fallback: might guy jiraiya shukuba anime scene

lines.text: His reason? He was too busy avoiding Itachi's Sharingan to get a good look.

lines.text: Guy would not even look at those eyes. That tells you the rule matters more than the mood.

shot.fallback: itachi sharingan might guy anime scene

lines.text: So what exactly does Tsukuyomi demand from a target?

shot.fallback: itachi tsukuyomi mangekyo anime scene

lines.text: Here's the rule everything hangs on. Only an Uchiha with the Mangekyo can cast Tsukuyomi.

shot.fallback: mangekyo sharingan itachi anime scene

lines.text: The wiki cites chapter 142 for it: a world of his own design, bending space, gravity, even time.

shot.fallback: tsukuyomi itachi red sky anime scene

lines.text: Genjutsu normally can't kill. The wiki says Tsukuyomi could, if Itachi wanted it to.

shot.fallback: itachi tsukuyomi lethal anime scene

lines.text: Even survivors are hospitalised for long stretches. Keep that in mind, because two of them are about to come up.

shot.fallback: kakashi sasuke hospital anime scene

lines.text: It works with either eye. Amaterasu is the one that needs his right.

shot.fallback: itachi mangekyo both eyes anime scene

lines.text: No eye contact, no Tsukuyomi. That's step one, every single time.

shot.fallback: two ninja locking eyes

lines.text: Watch Kakashi. He catches a glimpse of Itachi's Mangekyo and orders Asuma and Kurenai to shut their eyes.

shot.fallback: kakashi itachi asuma kurenai sharingan anime scene

lines.text: That order saves them. A target who looks away is a target Itachi can't touch with it.

shot.fallback: kakashi asuma kurenai eyes closed anime scene

lines.text: Kakashi doesn't escape. Tsukuyomi puts him through three days of torment in a few seconds.

shot.fallback: kakashi tsukuyomi three days anime scene

lines.text: Three days in seconds. That's what one landed look is worth.

shot.fallback: kakashi tsukuyomi torment anime scene

lines.text: He gave the same treatment to Yashiro Uchiha, days of torment in an instant, as revenge.

shot.fallback: itachi yashiro uchiha tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: That's the tone of the technique. It doesn't scare people. It breaks them.

shot.fallback: itachi tsukuyomi breaking anime scene

lines.text: And Itachi's own line about Kakashi is telling: he says that fight wouldn't take any time at all.

shot.fallback: itachi kisame kakashi fight anime scene

lines.text: He isn't boasting. He's efficient, and that's the part that worries me.

shot.fallback: itachi efficient fight anime scene

lines.text: So Itachi never needed to cast it often. He needed it to land once.

shot.fallback: itachi uchiha mangekyo cast anime scene

lines.text: But the rule cuts both ways. Itachi said only a Sharingan user from his own clan could break it.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke sharingan clan anime scene

lines.text: And in their final battle, Sasuke breaks free of Tsukuyomi. So the rule is real.

shot.fallback: sasuke itachi final battle tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: Now flip that onto Naruto. He has no Sharingan, so nothing on his side can break it.

shot.fallback: naruto uzumaki no sharingan anime scene

lines.text: My read: that makes him an easy target on paper, which is exactly why the question is so strange.

shot.fallback: naruto uzumaki serious face anime scene

lines.text: Itachi looked at everyone else who mattered. So why not him?

shot.fallback: itachi looking at naruto anime scene

lines.text: Sasuke is the one target Itachi aimed Tsukuyomi at twice, and both times it was personal.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: The night his clan falls, he shows Sasuke their parents' deaths as a vision. Chapter 403 is where it's told.

shot.fallback: uchiha clan district itachi sasuke anime scene

lines.text: At Shukuba Town, he replays those deaths again and again, then tells Sasuke he's still weak.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke shukuba tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: Sasuke ends up hospitalised, comatose like Kakashi, until Tsunade heals them.

shot.fallback: sasuke hospital tsunade anime scene

lines.text: There's something strange in that night, too. Sasuke's newly awakened Sharingan attacks him, and fails.

shot.fallback: sasuke newly awakened sharingan anime scene

lines.text: He passes out, but not before glimpsing Itachi crying. He forgets it for years.

shot.fallback: itachi crying sasuke anime scene

lines.text: My read: a man who cries afterwards isn't using his best weapon at full cruelty.

shot.fallback: itachi tears sasuke anime scene

lines.text: Here's the part I keep chewing on. One fan analysis says Itachi purposely weakened it against his brother.

shot.fallback: itachi uchiha holding back anime scene

lines.text: My read: he had the strong version in his hands, and he chose a weaker one on purpose.

shot.fallback: itachi mangekyo restraint anime scene

lines.text: Why would a man with that power use less of it on his own brother?

shot.fallback: older ninja looking at a younger ninja

lines.text: The wiki says he cast himself as the villain, to push Sasuke down the road of revenge.

shot.fallback: itachi villain sasuke revenge anime scene

lines.text: So I think Itachi wasn't trying to end Sasuke. He was trying to shape him.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke teaching anime scene

lines.text: That's a theory, not something the anime spells out in one line.

shot.fallback: two ninja talking under a tree

lines.text: But it fits the way he talks to Sasuke all through the story.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke conversation anime scene

lines.text: One source says Sasuke later trained his mind against the technique, and that it shortened the effect.

shot.fallback: sasuke training mind anime scene

lines.text: So even on his brother, it was never a sure win. That's another reason for care.

shot.fallback: sasuke sharingan determined anime scene

lines.text: Now compare the other targets. Kakashi, Yashiro, Sasuke. Each one stood in his way or in his story.

shot.fallback: itachi kakashi sasuke anime scene

lines.text: Naruto has no family tie to Itachi, just distance.

shot.fallback: naruto itachi distance anime scene

lines.text: In my read, Tsukuyomi was how Itachi settled things, not how he ended fights.

shot.fallback: itachi tsukuyomi settle anime scene

lines.text: That's the pattern. But did anyone ever just shrug this technique off?

shot.fallback: naruto shrug off genjutsu anime scene

lines.text: Let's test the other side. Who has actually resisted Tsukuyomi?

shot.fallback: tsukuyomi resist sharingan anime scene

lines.text: Kakashi stays conscious through three days of it, which surprises even Kisame.

shot.fallback: kakashi kisame surprised anime scene

lines.text: He even works out why Itachi and Kisame are in Konoha, using what Jiraiya told him: they want the Nine-Tails.

shot.fallback: kakashi jiraiya akatsuki nine-tails anime scene

lines.text: That isn't immunity. It's will, and he's still out of the fight afterwards.

shot.fallback: kakashi unconscious guy carries anime scene

lines.text: Fan guides say Madara resisted it with his Sharingan and Rinnegan, and cite Obito for willpower.

shot.fallback: madara uchiha rinnegan anime scene

lines.text: Those are fan takes, so I'm holding them loosely.

shot.fallback: obito uchiha will anime scene

lines.text: What the wiki does say, in chapter 677, is that Sasuke's Rinnegan repels Infinite Tsukuyomi.

shot.fallback: sasuke rinnegan infinite tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: One analysis argues the Rinnegan deters it without fully cancelling it.

shot.fallback: rinnegan infinite tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: That same analysis says genjutsu immunity on its own doesn't exist.

shot.fallback: ninja caught in a dark illusion

lines.text: So resisting takes tools or will, and Naruto has neither a Sharingan nor a Rinnegan in these fights.

shot.fallback: naruto uzumaki nine-tails chakra anime scene

lines.text: I searched for Kurama blocking genjutsu, and I came up empty.

shot.fallback: kurama nine-tails naruto anime scene

lines.text: It matters because the sources I found never say Naruto could shake it off. They only say he never faced it.

shot.fallback: naruto no genjutsu immunity anime scene

lines.text: So I won't claim the Nine-Tails shields him, because I can't back it up.

shot.fallback: naruto kurama mode anime scene

lines.text: What I can say is that Naruto is loud, close and always moving. A staring contest is awkward.

shot.fallback: naruto uzumaki charging rasengan anime scene

lines.text: Infinite Tsukuyomi is a different technique, and a wiki says everyone under its gaze gets trapped.

shot.fallback: infinite tsukuyomi moon anime scene

lines.text: That suggests the eye-contact rule belongs to the regular version, the one Itachi had.

shot.fallback: itachi regular tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: So the real question isn't whether Naruto could resist. It's whether Itachi ever got a clean look.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto face to face anime scene

lines.text: Did he, in either fight where they shared a battlefield?

shot.fallback: itachi naruto battlefield anime scene

lines.text: The big clash comes in the episode titled Contact. Kabuto has brought Itachi back with Edo Tensei.

shot.search: Naruto Shippuden Contact Itachi Edo Tensei
shot.fallback: naruto shippuden contact itachi edo tensei anime scene

lines.text: Itachi is paired with Nagato, and he carries him, because Nagato's legs are damaged.

shot.fallback: itachi carrying nagato anime scene

lines.text: They talk about how little they ever knew about Akatsuki. They were never partners with Tobi, just useful.

shot.fallback: itachi nagato akatsuki talk anime scene

lines.text: Both of them were pawns Tobi kept for their eyes, and now Kabuto wants the same thing.

shot.fallback: itachi nagato edo tensei kabuto anime scene

lines.text: Kabuto forces them to fight Naruto and Killer B. Itachi isn't a free man here.

shot.fallback: naruto bee itachi nagato anime scene

lines.text: So this was never a clean duel between two free people.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto contact fight anime scene

lines.text: But the strangest part is the talking. Itachi and Nagato keep attacking, yet they give advice on how to evade.

shot.fallback: itachi advice naruto bee anime scene

lines.text: Naruto tells him Sasuke now works with Akatsuki to destroy Konoha, and Itachi is horrified.

shot.fallback: itachi horrified sasuke akatsuki anime scene

lines.text: He also sees Naruto's Nine-Tails Chakra Mode and understands that Naruto has finally gained control of it.

shot.fallback: naruto nine-tails chakra mode anime scene

lines.text: And Killer B's use of Samehada tells Itachi that Kisame is dead.

shot.fallback: bee samehada kisame anime scene

lines.text: A fight that's supposed to be a battle turns into a conversation.

shot.fallback: two ninja pausing mid battle

lines.text: Nobody reaches for the eyes. As I read the fight, the eyes never become the story.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto contact eyes anime scene

lines.text: Then Itachi does the thing that breaks Kabuto's grip himself.

shot.fallback: itachi crow genjutsu anime scene

lines.text: He calls out the crow he planted in Naruto before his death, and lets it use its genjutsu on him.

shot.fallback: itachi crow naruto anime scene

lines.text: That overrides Kabuto's control with a mission it was built for: protect Konoha.

shot.fallback: itachi crow konoha mission anime scene

lines.text: Think about that. The only genjutsu in that whole fight lands on Itachi himself, and it frees him.

shot.fallback: itachi freed kabuto control anime scene

lines.text: Then comes Itachi's cleanest act. He destroys the crow, and Shisui's eye with it, using Amaterasu.

shot.fallback: itachi amaterasu crow shisui eye anime scene

lines.text: So the one thing that could have ended up in the wrong hands is erased on purpose.

shot.fallback: shisui eye destroyed anime scene

lines.text: Now free, he joins Naruto and Killer B and burns Nagato's summons with Amaterasu.

shot.fallback: itachi amaterasu nagato summons anime scene

lines.text: Nagato throws Chibaku Tensei at them, and the three of them destroy it together.

shot.fallback: chibaku tensei naruto itachi anime scene

lines.text: Then Itachi stabs Nagato with the Sword of Totsuka, sealing him away.

shot.fallback: itachi totsuka sword nagato anime scene

lines.text: Before he leaves, he entrusts Sasuke's reform to Naruto. That's the closest thing to a message between them.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto sasuke entrust anime scene

lines.text: Naruto walks away knowing he can't carry everything alone. I think that's the lesson Itachi wanted to give him.

shot.fallback: naruto uzumaki realization anime scene

lines.text: Look at the pattern. Itachi talks most when the fight is least his own.

shot.fallback: itachi uchiha speaking anime scene

lines.text: And when Kabuto's hold breaks, his target is Nagato, not Naruto.

shot.fallback: itachi nagato totsuka anime scene

lines.text: That tells me who Itachi saw as the real problem in that battle.

shot.fallback: Kabuto watching from the shadows

lines.text: Now the earlier moment that looks like a counterexample. Nagato makes a body-double of Itachi to stall Team 7.

shot.fallback: nagato body double itachi team 7 anime scene

lines.text: It catches Naruto in a genjutsu and torments him over failing to protect Sasuke, until his teammates break it.

shot.fallback: naruto genjutsu team 7 itachi double anime scene

lines.text: Itachi is impressed by Naruto's growth in that fight, and it ends when Naruto lands a Big Ball Rasengan.

shot.fallback: naruto big ball rasengan itachi anime scene

lines.text: Even then, he's only a copy, buying time while Akatsuki finishes sealing the One-Tail.

shot.fallback: akatsuki one-tail sealing anime scene

lines.text: The wiki calls it a genjutsu, not Tsukuyomi, and the one steering that copy is Nagato.

shot.fallback: nagato pain steering itachi anime scene

lines.text: So I count it as the exception that proves the rule. Itachi himself never chose to cast on Naruto.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto rasengan double anime scene

lines.text: But fans still have three arguments against me, and I owe them a fair hearing.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto debate anime scene

lines.text: First, the spy. The wiki says Itachi only pretended to pursue Naruto, to let Konoha learn what Akatsuki wanted.

shot.fallback: itachi akatsuki konoha spy anime scene

lines.text: If he never meant to capture Naruto, he had no reason to use the eyes. That's a strong argument.

shot.fallback: itachi uchiha eyes closed anime scene

lines.text: Add the crow he planted in Naruto before dying. Its mission was built to protect Konoha, not to harm Naruto.

shot.fallback: itachi crow naruto anime scene

lines.text: Its gap: he still used Tsukuyomi on Sasuke and Kakashi while the same mission was running.

shot.fallback: itachi kakashi sasuke tsukuyomi anime scene

lines.text: Second, the cost. He was sick, so Tsukuyomi was simply too expensive for him.

shot.fallback: itachi illness cost anime scene

lines.text: I'd grant that right away, because it fits Jiraiya, and it's the most common fan answer.

shot.fallback: itachi coughing anime scene

lines.text: But it has a hole: he paid for Tsukuyomi on his brother with a Sannin in the room.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke jiraiya standoff anime scene

lines.text: If cost were everything, why spend that power on Sasuke and not hold it for the real threat?

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke cost power anime scene

lines.text: Third, mercy. The wiki calls him a pacifist at heart, so maybe he just didn't want to hurt Naruto.

shot.fallback: itachi pacifist gentle anime scene

lines.text: The gap: the same man gave Yashiro days of torment in an instant, and Kakashi three days in seconds.

shot.fallback: itachi merciless yashiro kakashi anime scene

lines.text: So mercy isn't his default setting. It has to be earned.

shot.fallback: itachi uchiha cold anime scene

lines.text: Each argument covers part of the picture, and none covers all of it.

shot.fallback: itachi three arguments anime scene

lines.text: Mercy and spy work even overlap. A pacifist spy has two reasons to leave Naruto alone.

shot.fallback: itachi pacifist spy anime scene

lines.text: Cost and mercy overlap too. A sick man is careful about whom he spends his strength on.

shot.fallback: itachi spends strength anime scene

lines.text: That's the honest state of this theory. Every reason has a piece of truth, and every reason has a gap.

shot.fallback: itachi puzzle theory anime scene

lines.text: So which gap is the one that matters most?

shot.fallback: two ninja facing each other in silence

lines.text: Here's my verdict, labeled as a theory and not canon.

shot.fallback: ninja standing tall at dusk

lines.text: My read: Tsukuyomi was a tool for a specific job, and Naruto never fit that job.

shot.fallback: Sharingan eyes over a dark background

lines.text: Every use we see is about getting inside a head Itachi needed to reach. Sasuke. Kakashi. Yashiro.

shot.fallback: itachi tsukuyomi targets anime scene

lines.text: Jiraiya was a threat to run from. Naruto was a mission he was only pretending to chase.

shot.fallback: itachi jiraiya naruto anime scene

lines.text: And in Contact, the eyes stayed closed in the one fight where the two of them could really talk.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto contact talk anime scene

lines.text: The one copy that did catch Naruto in a genjutsu was Nagato's puppet, not Itachi's choice.

shot.fallback: nagato puppet itachi anime scene

lines.text: So it isn't just illness, just mercy, or just spy work.

shot.fallback: itachi reasons anime scene

lines.text: It's the combination: a technique that's costly, rule-bound, and kept for people Itachi had to reach.

shot.fallback: itachi tsukuyomi combination anime scene

lines.text: Naruto was the wrong target, in the wrong fight, under the wrong hand.

shot.fallback: naruto itachi wrong target anime scene

lines.text: Here's what I think the whole thing really shows, and it's the part that gets me.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto emotional anime scene

lines.text: Itachi's flaw was manipulating Sasuke instead of being honest with him and trusting him.

shot.fallback: itachi sasuke manipulation anime scene

lines.text: With Naruto he does the opposite. He gives advice, he talks, and he hands Sasuke's future to him.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto trust anime scene

lines.text: You use Tsukuyomi on someone you need to control. Naruto is the one person Itachi trusts.

shot.fallback: itachi trusts naruto anime scene

lines.text: That also explains why the copy in the earlier fight matters so little. It's Nagato's hand, not his own.

shot.fallback: nagato itachi copy anime scene

lines.text: Now the prediction, because every good theory has to commit to something.

shot.fallback: two ninja facing a sunrise

lines.text: If Itachi and Naruto ever got a free fight, I expect Tsukuyomi to be the trap.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto free fight anime scene

lines.text: Naruto would have to meet his eyes first, and the rule says that's the hard part.

shot.fallback: Naruto locking eyes with a Sharingan

lines.text: Once he does, the question shifts from can it work to what it costs to keep it going.

shot.fallback: ninja struggling under a dark aura

lines.text: A free fight would test whether the restraint was about the cost, or about the target.

shot.fallback: two ninja circling in a ruined field

lines.text: That's the question the series never fully answers. I'd bet on the target, though.

shot.fallback: itachi naruto bet target anime scene

lines.text: Itachi spent his life choosing who deserved his eyes, and I think Naruto earned something better.

shot.fallback: itachi eyes naruto deserve anime scene

lines.text: My final read: Itachi never used Tsukuyomi on Naruto because Naruto was never the person he needed inside his head.

shot.fallback: Sharingan eyes glowing in the dark

lines.text: And if you want to see what Naruto's own eyes might do, that's the next story.
